exposure: 10 mg of 0.5% hyperbaric bupivacaine for spinal anesthesia
12 mg of 0.5% hyperbaric bupivacaine for spinal anesthesia
cohort: Ninety pregnant women undergoing cesarean section.
finding: A dose of 12 mg of 0.5% hyperbaric bupivacaine for spinal anesthesia in cesarean sections produces excellent anesthesia and maternal satisfaction without complications.
